t: Milwaukee Shockwave 1/2" 50mm Hex Shank PZ2 Impact Screwdriver Bits are engineered for professional trade use, delivering durable and reliable fastening for heavy-duty applications. These 50mm impact driver bits are ideal for demanding jobsite tasks, from electrical installations and general construction to workshop projects. Manufactured from custom-engineered steel, they offer increased resistance to shock from impact driving. The laser-hardened Wear Guard Tip ensures enhanced wear resistance and a precise fit, while optimised Shockzone geometry flexes to reduce stress and minimise breakages, absorbing impacts with a spring-like action for long-lasting performance.
